title: Support for ed25519 encryption
description: A PR that will add ed25519 encryption support.

title: Create non-serialized files for access through other languages
description:
#45 
This is my first draft. A separate file is created for the key and the message. At this point, the message must be a simple string, as there is no information about it except length save in the file.
A python example for reading the encrypted message is included.

title: Add a vignette and link documentation topics
description:
We now have a vignette, sharing most of the content of the README. To do this, I use `knitr` child documents.

I also updated the documentation, adding information that a vault no longer has to be part of a package. In addition, I added `see also` sections linking the help topics for vault, users and secrets.

title: Multiple changes, including adding travis and github keys; new README; and updated tests
description: Add new function `add_travis_user()`; imports `httr` to read travis key

title: Enhancements and bug fixes
description:
Enhancements:

* Define `local_key()`
* Support vault outside a package
* Improved documentation

Bug fixes

* Correctly delete encrypted secret files when deleting a user

title: Add unit test framework
description:
The unit tests creates a fake package in `tempdir()`, then creates a vault and adds users and secrets.

Inside the `tests`, I added public and private keys for two users. These are accessed by the tests to encrypt and decrypt secrets.
